title: ONE CAREER — League Data Pack
description: A country pyramid: divisions, clubs, and promotion/relegation wiring. ClubIdentity (name/colors/stadium) is intentionally separable from ClubSimulation (reputation/finance/tactics) so a licensed identity pack can be swapped in without touching saves or AI.

season.description: Season the club lists describe. All divisions in one pack MUST share a season so the pyramid stays internally consistent.

confidence.description: Pack-level default. Individual divisions may override.

columns.description: Column order for every row in every division's `clubs` array. Row-major storage keeps ~500-club packs small and diff-friendly.

group.description: Regional group label for split tiers (Serie C Girone A, Primera Federación Grupo 1, ...).

reputation_band.description: [min, max] expected club reputation in this division. Used to sanity-check club rows and to seed wage/transfer scale.

wage_scale.description: Multiplier on the global base wage curve. Tier 1 of a top-5 country is ~1.0.

to.description: Target division id, or null for the top/bottom of the modelled pyramid.

playoff_field.description: How many clubs enter the play-off bracket.

x-column-glossary.id: Stable snake_case key, prefixed by country code. Never reused, never derived from table position.
x-column-glossary.name: Full club name as commonly written in English.
x-column-glossary.abbr: 3-letter code for tables, scorebug and small UI. Unique within a country.
x-column-glossary.city: Home city — drives travel load, derby detection and relocation storylets.
x-column-glossary.stadium: Home ground name. Best-effort for lower tiers; overridable in the editor.
x-column-glossary.founded: Year founded. Feeds club-history and legacy text. 0 = unknown.
x-column-glossary.rep: Reputation 0-100. A DESIGN value, not a fact: drives scouting reach, wage ceiling, transfer pull and media pressure.
x-column-glossary.primary: Primary kit colour (hex). Feeds the Kit Composer and the UI accent.
